name: Julie Miles

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Julie Miles’s “August for Jamie” returns to the month of its title as a measure of enduring love. Rain, soil, breath and a river of tears give grief a physical presence, while the repeated arrival of August sets calendar time against a bond that does not fade.

The poem also questions the rituals and language of anniversaries: whether their familiar words can reach the depth of remembrance. Its direct address to Jamie keeps that question intimate, ending with a presence felt in August and beyond it.
